title: Online User Agreement pages p1-p7 as vtex1 DDS from the PS3 http-cache (eula-batch/make_eula.py)
notes: The 7 pages are the JPEGs BCES-EN-1..7 the PS3 game cached in DATA2/USRDIR/http-cache (recognised by content sha256): Pillow flip + JPEG q95 re-save, ffmpeg lanczos mips, DXT5. Verified 2026-11-05: 7/7 byte-identical with Pillow 13.0.0 + ffmpeg 8.1.1 (msys2 clang64). Without ffmpeg the Pillow resize gives equivalent pages (75-88 % identical DXT blocks). The helper-side EULA page code (eula_port.c.txt / apply_eula.py) is a helper build change, not part of this step.
